# Slate

> Slate publishes small, focused Atlassian Marketplace apps that run entirely inside the
> customer's own Atlassian cloud. Every app carries the "Runs on Atlassian" badge: no external
> servers, no data egress, inheriting Atlassian's SOC 2 / ISO 27001 and data residency.

## Apps
- Dwell — time in status, cycle & lead time for Jira, with median and p85 rather than averages. The per-issue panel is free on every issue.
- Pact — working-time SLAs on ordinary Jira Software issues, without Jira Service Management.
- Warden — an access audit for Confluence: every restricted page, and the restrictions that quietly broke.
